def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    
    # Ensure numeric columns are actually numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Fix sex label variant (FEMALE -> female)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower()
    
    # Remove out of range body_mass_g values (should be 2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Remove negative flipper_length_mm values
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 0]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
